one monthly payout to an investor: 60 records per Issued 5-year allotment, created by the console's schedule job (no unique key: the job reads before it inserts); Finance marks each Paid with the bank UTR and types TDS (D82, D84)

Module Investor_Payouts (CustomModule11, created 25 Sep, D82); 'Payouts' is a Zoho reserved name. Fields below. Allotment is the parent; no Contact lookup (the investor is reached through the allotment's Customer). Annual_Rental_Yield stays on the allotment
readable natural key '<allotment id>-NN' (NN = instalment, two digits)
Primary field of the module; written by the schedule job, not unique in Zoho
the allotment the payout belongs to
Rental yield / Exit / Refund / Other; the schedule job writes Rental yield
the month the payout is for, stored as the first day (YYYY-MM-01)
due date: the 10th of the month, the first one the month after the allotment was issued
monthly gross in whole rupees: Issued_Units x Unit_Price x Annual_Rental_Yield / 100 / 12, rounded
TDS typed by Finance when paying, 0 by default; the console never works it out (D84)
Gross_Amount minus TDS_Amount, written by the console with the paid mark
Scheduled / Paid / Held / Failed / Cancelled; a payout is paid once
the day the money went out; not in the future (IST)
the bank's UTR; required to mark Paid; one transfer pays one payout (the console checks, Zoho has no unique rule); never logged, shown masked to the last four
the Finance user who marked it paid (the token user)
why a payout is Held, Failed or Cancelled (e.g. returned by the bank)
